meta.title: Siaya County: analytical measures calculated from published figures
meta.label: Calculated by Takwimu Kenya from published figures
meta.rule: Every result is arithmetic on values already in the repository; each input names its dataset, record, value, unit, source and page. Numerator and denominator come from the same source document. Values are never averaged across sources, a missing or non-comparable input gives a gap record with its reason, and nothing is filled. No verdicts: rates and counts are shown with their caveats.

families.A1: Real per-capita county expenditure (FY 2024/25 prices; census count and projections kept distinct)
families.A2: Transfer dependency per fiscal year and source document
families.A3: Execution (absorption) rates, same document and budget version, beside printed rates (R-002)
families.A4: Pending bills: stocks by date, changes within one document or declared series, roll-forward residuals (R-003)
families.A5: Audit recurrence: findings by category, stated carry-overs, next-year unresolved lists, repeated named items
families.A7: Climate financing beside PCRA risk; allocation, receipt and expenditure kept separate (R-005)

conventions.money: Results in KSh million unless the unit says otherwise; KSh billion inputs are multiplied by 1,000 and KSh inputs divided by 1,000,000.
conventions.rounding: Percentages and KSh million to 2 decimals; per-capita KSh to whole shillings. The test allows a tolerance of half a unit in the last decimal.
conventions.fiscal_year_matching: A calendar-year figure for year Y is paired only with the fiscal year that starts in July of Y (FY Y/Y+1).
conventions.same_document: Readings of one measure in one document that agree within 1% are the same figure at different rounding: the most precise (table reading first) is used and the others are listed. Readings that differ by more than 1% are a conflict and give a gap.
conventions.deflator: data/cpi.json fiscal-year index; base FY 2024/25 = 100 (approximate: average of two calendar years).
conventions.not_used: data/siaya-economy.json (Gross County Product) and data/siaya-agriculture.json were read but no requested measure uses them.
